claims.statement: GUNB states that buildings require at least five-year technical checks including electrical and lightning-protection installations, and large buildings can require checks twice yearly.

ZGN Wola's 2026 procurement plan budgeted 200,000 PLN gross for five-year building, sanitary and electrical inspections, evidencing a specific existing inspection budget rather than the size of the national market.
A combined calendar, protocol-QA and contractor-dispatch product may capture more value than a generic reminder tool.
The willingness of private managers to pay a separate software fee above the inspection contract is unknown.

contrary_evidence: c-KOB and established property-management systems already store part of the statutory record.
Inspection purchasing is price-sensitive, regulated work must remain with qualified people and public procurement has long sales cycles.
Five-year work alone is not recurring enough; the product must aggregate annual, event-triggered and remediation workflows.

economics.acquisition_route: Partner with licensed electricians and inspectors, property-management software vendors and insurers; use the family installation network to seed electrical inspection supply in Wielkopolska.
economics.founder_time: Part-time validation hypothesis; delivery burden remains untested.

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: Structured defect frequencies, remediation cost, building type, inspector reliability and repeat-failure data can improve quoting, routing and preventive recommendations.
fingerprint.customer: Polish housing-community managers, small commercial-property portfolios, municipal property units and qualified building, electrical and gas inspectors.
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: Partner with licensed electricians and inspectors, property-management software vendors and insurers; use the family installation network to seed electrical inspection supply in Wielkopolska.
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: A building register that calculates due dates, bundles scopes, dispatches verified inspectors, checks protocol completeness from photos and measurements, tracks defect remediation and exports a c-KOB-ready evidence packet. Start as managed software for private managers before pursuing public tenders.
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: The owner or property manager already tenders or buys each qualified inspection. Charge per building per year for the compliance calendar and take a transparent dispatch margin on inspections; a Warsaw public procurement plan demonstrates a real budget but is not representative of private portfolios.
fingerprint.problem_trigger: A building reaches an annual, five-year or large-building twice-yearly inspection deadline, or an external event triggers an additional safety inspection; asset lists, contractor availability, protocols, defect follow-up and c-KOB-ready evidence must line up.

founder_fit: Connects family-business electrical capability with an automation and data layer.
Can begin locally with a managed marketplace and become software-led.
Does not require the founder to perform regulated inspections personally.
risks: Evidence of a workflow, transition, or loss does not yet establish recurring willingness to pay.
The proposed distribution and compounding mechanisms remain hypotheses pending buyer evidence.

title: Inspection operating system and dispatch network for property managers
uncertainties: Whether c-KOB supports a practical integration or only manual export and entry.
Inspector supply density and gross margin after travel, insurance and rework.
Which private segment has enough buildings to value scheduling but is not locked into a national facilities provider?
Pricing, buyer authority, and acquisition economics remain unvalidated at discovery.

First validation test: Import the calendars of five managers covering at least 200 buildings, identify due or incomplete inspections, and run one inspection cycle with two licensed partners. Seek a paid per-building renewal only if protocol QA and routing cut manager administration by at least half without increasing the inspection price.
